objective: Replace imagegen-as-font styling with actually authored vector stroke design, inspectable native Figma nodes and verifiable structure/art direction.
current_problem: R24 produced raster glyph images with no documented font source and zero editable Figma strokes; method distillation/aesthetic gain unproven.
design_source_author: 梁志坚 2019 字体实战设计教程（作者原文）
source_support: Author explains whole group optical-weight and common gesture choices, then selectively rewrites crowded glyphs, not arbitrary rescaling; no original artist paths copied.
why_minimal: Different structural families: 山 is open-three-spine with lower crossbar; 月 has frame/inner bars/hook. Design both completely from handmade Bézier contours to test one shared visual grammar with only 2 glyphs before scaling to four.
not_the_R24_word: Intentionally uses smaller tractable word to prove actual manual/native vector creation without mislabeling 4-glyph complete skill.
art_direction: Chinese contemporary lyrical logo, condensed rising stems, deep charcoal black, differentiated stroke weights and tapered terminal gestures, ample inner negative space; black path only, no texture or scene.

frozen_design_decisions.mechanism: Three upright spines remain visibly separate; visually central spine is tallest; long basal horizontal tethers left and right while retaining two white counters
frozen_design_decisions.reject: glyph reads 川, 凹 or a generic mountain drawing

frozen_design_decisions.mechanism: Enclosing left sweep, top cap and right hooked vertical form readable 月; upper/lower internal bars retain clear apertures
frozen_design_decisions.reject: looks 日/目/用 or inner space closed

frozen_design_decisions.mechanism: Optical mass balance via stronger 山 spine and 月 right hook; related taper and terminal angle, not the same flourish copied to all strokes
frozen_design_decisions.reject: independent fonts placed side by side

frozen_design_decisions.mechanism: Only source-authored cubic contour paths with per-stroke identities in an isolated new Figma file; do not import/raster-trace any PNG, SVG font glyph or artist source
frozen_design_decisions.reject: TEXT nodes masquerading as original paths, flatten bitmap, or SVG auto-trace

frozen_design_decisions.mechanism: One baseline hand-authored scaffold and one deliberate contour rewrite in exactly documented selected paths; compare and retain original
frozen_design_decisions.reject: just changing x scaling, ink texture, or random path smoothing

production.isolation: Dedicated new Figma file. No writes to mainline existing file uyDxOoN1iNDPpEHTKSUWg1 or production lock 355 / checkpoint 377.
production.expected_nodes: Editable SVG path vectors imported into Figma, grouped by named glyph and stroke. Each visible final path must be independently selectable; no text or bitmap vector-traced.
production.local_mirror: Source-authored SVG/PNG and SHA readback in user attachment, GitHub research text and code metadata.
production.budget: No Firefly, no new paid API. Existing connected Figma plan only.

validation.must: Actual Figma native file write + re-read nodes; screenshot whole wordmark; local SVG raster QA; classify structural typography and separate unknown aesthetic.
validation.user_approval: NOT_RECEIVED for 山月; only previous local approval of 喜 segment, unrelated.
validation.not_claim: Learning full original designer creative steps, commercial master, generalizable multi-glyph Skill, or human blind preference

next_gate: If at least one authored coherent wordmark and native vectors pass, obtain independent readability and aesthetic review; then hold out dissimilar two-glyph word before claiming repeatable rule.
